character.name: Idle
character.prompt: Full-body standing idle sprite of a Chinese male school discipline director, elderly adult about 58 years old. His defining features must be clearly readable: a bald shiny crown with a horseshoe ring of dark gray hair around the sides and back, very thick heavy old-fashioned reading spectacles with large square frames and thick pale lenses, stern serious face. Wearing a tidy dark charcoal school administrator jacket, light shirt, straight dark trousers and black shoes. Neutral empty hands by his sides. Match the supplied student's retro pixel-art style, restrained small palette, crisp single-pixel outlines and simple shading, same pixel density and in-game scale. Slight overhead low top-down orthographic view showing a little of the head top, no perspective shrinking. Centered south-facing full-body neutral standing pose, both feet grounded at the same level. Native 32 by 48 transparent canvas, aim for visible height 40 pixels, leave about 4 pixels under the feet and headroom above. No scenery, no floor, no lettering, no watermark, no blurry antialiasing, no cast shadow.
